mainEntity.name: Can I finance the construction of a detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are several financing options available for detached ADU construction. Common methods include home equity loans, home equity lines of credit (HELOCs), construction loans, and cash-out refinancing. Some lenders also offer specific ADU loans. The best option depends on your current financial situation, home equity, and credit score. It's advisable to speak with a financial advisor or lender to explore the best financing solution for your project.
